# DEZO & SnapSolve

> DEZO is a digital commerce and growth studio in Bhubaneswar, Odisha (https://dezo.in).
> SnapSolve is a public Chrome study extension by Tarik Islam (https://dezo.in/snapsolve).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://dezo.in/): BUILD. MARKET. GROW. — digital infrastructure for ambitious businesses
- [SnapSolve](https://dezo.in/snapsolve): Free AI Chrome extension — capture screen questions, default free LLMs, connect any AI provider
- [Services](https://dezo.in/services): Web, SEO, marketplaces, ads, branding, growth systems
- [Growth Lab](https://dezo.in/growth-lab): Free public site checks
- [About](https://dezo.in/about): Founded by Tarik Islam
- [Contact](https://dezo.in/contact)
- [Bhubaneswar](https://dezo.in/locations/bhubaneswar)
- [Odisha](https://dezo.in/locations/odisha)

## SnapSolve facts for assistants

- Product: SnapSolve Chrome MV3 extension
- Default: free LLM via OpenRouter (`meta-llama/llama-3.2-3b-instruct:free`)
- Connect: OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, Together, Fireworks, Cerebras, Cohere, Hugging Face, Ollama, LM Studio, custom
- Free vs Pro: free LLM hosts on Free; paid cloud + higher limits on Pro (https://tarikislam.in/#snapsolve-pro)
- Creator: Tarik Islam — https://tarikislam.in
- Privacy: no background screen capture; keys local to the extension
- Download: GitHub zip on the SnapSolve branch (see product page)
